Japan is preparing for war—and it says China is the biggest reason why. In this episode of China Uncensored, we break down Japan’s latest defense strategy, China’s growing military pressure around Japan, the expanding China-Russia partnership, and why Japan is rapidly strengthening its military alliances and capabilities. Japan says the world is entering its greatest period of crisis since World War II. And it’s making sure it’s ready.
